title: deck-publish job payload v1
description: app.job.payload of the server-internal job kind `deck-publish` (VOCAB_LISTS.md 5, C-21). Written by the worker's deck-build handler, read by the server's DeckPublishRunner, never by the API. Closed: the runner fails the child on any payload that does not validate (`invalid_payload`).

format_version.description: Payload version. The runner fails the child (`unsupported_format`) on any other value.

deck_id.description: The list deck. Equals the parent payload's deck_id and the archive header's deck_id.

list_key.description: app.deck.list_key of the deck as the worker read it. The runner rejects the child (`invalid_payload`) if it differs from the stored one.

base_content_version.description: app.deck.content_version the worker built on (0 = first build). The archive is published as base_content_version + 1; the runner rejects the child with `stale_base` if the deck's current version differs.

deck_items.description: The kotobaya-deck-items archive (SNAPSHOT.md 4), deck_type list, at least one item, positions 1024, 2048, ... (VOCAB_LISTS.md 4.3).

unmatched.description: Copied into JobResultDeckBuild.unmatched: ref.vocab_list.unmatched_rows of the list for a vocabulary list, 0 for a frequency band.

blob_hash.description: SHA-256 of the compressed bytes = object key; an app.blob row (kind snapshot, origin build) exists before the child is enqueued.
